mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, today's conditions are overcast with a temperature of 73 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail, under a waxing crescent moon.

The Verona Senior Center is currently recruiting volunteers to assist with their programs. You are asked to commit to at least two shifts per month, and please note that some roles involve physical tasks like lifting and climbing stairs. The Center emphasizes the importance of integrity and strict participant confidentiality for all volunteers.

We have plenty going on in town. Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run or the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead to tomorrow, Epic Systems is hosting their annual User Group Meeting, and Insight Wellness offers yoga classes.
In a noteworthy update from last week, on August 8, an officer located two juveniles walking on Barbara Street and cited them for underage alcohol consumption and curfew violations.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. The restaurant is currently closed but will be opening at 10 AM. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, it will be Caramel Peanut Buttercup.
